brief:
Israeli forces killed a United Nations worker and two other Palestinians across Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The deaths occurred as military operations continued in the territory following a ceasefire agreement reached in October 2025.

At least 1,679 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire took effect. The deaths represent a continued toll of violence despite the formal agreement intended to halt hostilities.
